items.name: HL · Consent at checkout → Brevo
items.what: After a verified payment, adds the customer to Brevo's opted-in list only if they ticked the marketing box, records when and where they agreed, and otherwise only updates LAST_ORDER_DATE for people who opted in earlier.
setup: Authenticate mail.harvestlane.example in Brevo (DKIM, verification code, DMARC p=none, one SPF record ending in ~all) before any campaign.
In Brevo, create the list "Customers · opted in" and the contact attributes FIRSTNAME, SEGMENT, FAV_CATEGORY, LAST_ORDER_DATE (date), USUAL_ORDER_DAY.
Run the marketing_consent table SQL from the Brevo setup sticky note in Supabase.
Create a Header Auth credential "Brevo API key": Name api-key, Value your Brevo API key. Select it in both Brevo nodes.
Create a Postgres credential with your Supabase database connection details and select it in every Postgres node.
Replace YOUR_BREVO_LIST_ID with the list's numeric ID.

In HL·03, after the payment is verified, add an Execute Workflow node that calls this workflow with email, first_name, segment, fav_category, order_date, usual_order_day, marketing_consent and consent_source.
Build the welcome, win-back and re-order automations in Brevo as the sticky note describes.
items.test: Click Test workflow with the pinned order (consent true): the contact appears in Brevo's list with lowercase email and attributes, and marketing_consent has a row. Change marketing_consent to false and use a new email: nothing is added.

items.name: HL · Weekly newsletter
items.what: Every Thursday, drafts the newsletter from the sheets, blocks any price or offer not in them, lets Tolu choose a subject and approve, then creates the Brevo campaign with UTM-tagged links and sends it at 17:00 unless email is paused.
setup: Add tabs Price list (product, price), In season (item, note), Customer stories (story, approved), Approved offers (offer) and Settings (setting, value) with a row email_paused false.
Select your Google Sheets credential in every sheet node and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Select your OpenAI credential and replace YOUR_MODEL.
Select your Telegram credential in the Telegram nodes and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
Select the "Brevo API key" credential in both Brevo nodes.
In Config, replace YOUR_BREVO_LIST_ID, YOUR_BREVO_TEST_LIST_ID (a list with only your own addresses) and YOUR_ORDER_LINK. Keep test_mode true until Tolu approves going live.
items.test: Click Test workflow: Tolu gets the draft with three subjects. Approve subject 2: a campaign is created for the test list and goes out at 17:00 (for a quick test, shorten the Wait). Add a fake 20% discount to a section by hand in the Check node's input, or remove a price from the sheet: the draft is blocked.

walk.title: Build it: a newsletter that lands, and only says what's true
walk.sample: Week 41 · Price list (tatashe, ugu, tomatoes) · ugu in season · one approved restaurant story · no approved offers

steps.say: Two things come before any campaign. Authenticate mail.harvestlane.example in Brevo with DKIM, one SPF record ending in tilde all, and DMARC at p equals none. And only people who ticked the box at checkout are on the list.
Every Thursday morning we draft, so Tolu has the day to approve before the 5 p.m. send.
Test mode stays on until Tolu approves going live. It sends to a test list with only your own addresses.
We gather the facts from the sheets: prices, what's in season, one approved customer story, and the approved offers. The AI gets nothing else to work from.
The AI drafts from those facts only, with three subject options under 50 characters, a preview line and sections. It must never invent a discount or promise.
show: Use only the prices and offers given

steps.say: Then code checks every naira amount is in the price list and every percent is an approved offer. An invented 20 percent off is caught here.
show: ₦ amount not in Price list → problem
offer words with no approved offer → problem

steps.say: If anything fails, nothing goes to approval at all. Tolu is told exactly what was blocked, so she can fix the sheets.
Tolu reads the draft on Telegram, picks a subject, and approves or rejects. A person approves every campaign.
show: Telegram · Send and Wait · custom form

steps.say: The order link gets UTM tags, so we can count orders from email, not opens. The footer says why they get it, with Brevo's one-tap unsubscribe.
show: Footer: why you get this + Unsubscribe

steps.say: We create the campaign in Brevo from our authenticated subdomain, never from a free Gmail address, which can't pass DMARC.
show: Auth: Header Auth · Brevo API key

steps.say: Then we wait until 5 p.m., when customers plan tomorrow's cooking.
Just before sending, we read the pause setting again. Monday's report switches it on if complaints pass 0.1 percent, so a bad week stops the next send.
Then Brevo sends it, and Tolu gets a note with the subject. Unsubscribes and complaints come back by webhook and are honoured on every channel the same day.

walk.end: Run it: Tolu gets three subjects, approves one, and the campaign goes to your test list at five; slip in a fake discount and the draft is blocked instead.

items.name: HL · Unsubscribes everywhere
items.what: Receives Brevo unsubscribe, hard-bounce and spam-complaint events and marks the person in Supabase the same day so no channel markets to them again.
setup: Create a Postgres credential with your Supabase database connection details and select it in every Postgres node.

Replace YOUR_WEBHOOK_SECRET with a long random string, activate the workflow, and add the webhook in Brevo: https://YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN/webhook/hl-brevo-events?token=YOUR_WEBHOOK_SECRET with events unsubscribed, hard bounce and spam.
items.test: Unsubscribe a test contact from a test email: marketing_consent shows status unsubscribed with suppressed_at. A request without the token gets 401.

items.name: HL · Email · Monday report
items.what: Every Monday, reports delivered, clicks, orders from email, unsubscribes and complaints, and pauses the next send automatically if complaints pass 0.1%.
setup: Select the "Brevo API key" credential in Brevo · last campaign stats.
Create a Postgres credential with your Supabase database connection details and select it in every Postgres node. Adjust the orders query to your orders table (utm_source, total, created_at).
Select your Google Sheets credential and replace YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Select your Telegram credential and replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
items.test: After one test campaign, click Test workflow: Tolu gets the numbers without open rates. To test the pause, temporarily change 0.001 to 0 in Numbers: Settings gets email_paused true and the next newsletter stops before sending.
